description: This file defines the class MapContext, which provides a layered view over multiple maps organized in a deque. It allows push/pop operations on the context stack, retrieval, insertion, and removal of key-value pairs, with write operations affecting only the top of the stack. It also supports accessing localized values if contained.

classes.name: MapContext
classes.description: A Map implementation that overlays multiple maps in a deque, allowing layered, stacked mappings with localized access.

methods.name: getContexts
methods.description: Returns the deque of contexts (maps) that form this MapContext.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new empty map to the top of the context stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds an existing map to the top of the context stack.

methods.name: addToBottom
methods.description: Adds an existing map to the bottom of the context stack.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the top map from the context stack if more than one map exists.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Calculates the total number of distinct keys across all stacked maps.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if all maps in the stack are empty.

methods.name: entryStream
methods.description: Provides a stream of Map entries from the top map downward, ensuring each key is yielded only once.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if any map in the stack contains the specified key.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if any map in the stack contains the specified value.

methods.name: withContextContainingKey
methods.description: Helper to find the first map containing the key and apply a function to it.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key considering the layered maps.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a localized value for a name and locale if supported.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a key-value pair in the top map.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the top map.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Merges another map into the top map.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries in the top map.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of all keys across all maps.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable collection of all values across all maps.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of entries across all maps.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the nested maps with annotations.
